projects.name: 16-wheel rover (senior design project)
projects.description: Rover with a two-stage passive bogie suspension; a single central motor drives all 16 wheels through 36-tooth pulleys (nominal 1:1) and a multi-stage TPU belt network.
highlights: Lead CAD designer: built and owned the 115-occurrence Fusion 360 assembly (14 unique parts).
Generative-design bogie arm: 0.086 kg, minimum safety factor 2.3 (Fusion PLA material), maximum displacement 2.6 mm.
Printed and assembled prototype; ~4.6 kg PLA rover (estimated from CAD volumes) built for rough ground up a ~32° benchmark slope (50 mm rise over 80 mm).

projects.name: Ortam Aurora
projects.description: ESP32-S3 smart room monitor and sunrise alarm. v2 firmware is hardened (per-device setup password, API token, BLE passkey pairing; known limits in SECURITY.md) and flashed on hardware; the companion Flutter phone app is a separate project whose v2 token/PIN update is pending.
highlights: Four sensor modules (DHT22, BH1750, SGP30, MAX4466) and an OLED measure temperature, humidity, light, air quality and sound; live data over a built-in web dashboard, WebSocket, REST and BLE (4-characteristic GATT).
60-LED WS2812B strip runs a 30-minute fade that begins 30 minutes before local sunrise.
Breadboard wiring documented in 33 numbered steps.

projects.name: Arduino bench prototypes
projects.description: Ultrasonic proximity alert planned in Tinkercad and built on the bench in stages (sensor, LED zone code, small propeller fan), plus a servo-follow sketch rewritten in 2026 (not yet tested with a servo).
highlights: Super Fulffy: a soil-moisture plant-watering design in Tinkercad (Arduino Uno, soil sensor, micro servo); simulation only, no physical build.
Wiring for each build drawn as numbered breadboard guides.

projects.name: AI coding agent quality gate
projects.description: Development workflow where planner and implementer AI agents work behind an automated gate: lint, types, tests, coverage and mutation testing where a tool exists; merge only on green.
highlights: Same automated gate rolled out across 7 project repositories (6 distinct codebases).
Agents built a detector for tests unable to fail; flagged tests in one repository went from 45 to 14.

projects.name: Sesli Kitap
projects.description: Android app that turns PDF books into narrated Turkish audio: OCR fallback, LLM cleanup, text-to-speech with sentence highlight, quizzes, a voice discussion mode and a private-lesson mode that explains a chapter part by part, asks questions and grades the answers. Built by directing AI agents.
highlights: 100% line-coverage gate on business logic, enforced by CI.
1,500+ tests.

projects.name: Quant Engine
projects.description: Local research and paper-trading platform on real Binance and Yahoo Finance data, with no path to a real exchange: VWAP fills, drawdown kill switch, GARCH, VaR/ES, Markowitz and DCF models.

projects.name: AlphaPulse
projects.description: Local financial-intelligence terminal: news feed with AI analysis, portfolio with risk measures, a four-agent strategy debate and a compliance centre. Demo build runs on mock data with one command; no API key needed.
highlights: Nine CI jobs: lint, type-check and build, unit tests, Playwright and demo smoke tests, Python tests, Python lint and security scan, dependency scan, secret scan.

projects.name: Live voice translation
projects.description: Web app: speak Turkish, read English moments later; speech recognition, Gemini translation, auto-loop mode and conversation history.

projects.name: Habit coach
projects.description: Flutter app that helps people break a habit: daily tasks with points and a streak, and an AI coach that answers in chat.
